p.write_text('def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            if len(comp) == 1:
                y, x = comp[0]
                out[y][x] = 0
    return out
')
